title: Escape Room Tips for Families and Teens: How to Win
description: Escape room tips for families and teenagers: choosing a room, splitting the team, asking for hints, minimum ages and making it a brilliant birthday day out.
h1: Escape room tips for families and teens
intro: Escape rooms turn your family into a crack team of puzzle-solvers, and they’re one of the few days out teens and parents both get excited about. Here’s how to crush it.

image.alt: A neon sign for escape rooms

cardText: Choose the right room, split the team and know when to ask for hints.

blocks.title: Scout’s escape plan
blocks.text: Search the whole room first and shout out everything you find. Most teams get stuck because one clue is sitting in someone’s pocket!
points: Pick a beginner room for your first go
Put one person in charge of keeping track of clues
Asking for a hint is not cheating

sections.html:
• Difficulty: start with a beginner or family-rated room.
  • Theme: horror rooms are fun for older teens but often have higher age limits.
  • Team size: most rooms suit 2 to 6. Too many people can mean some just stand around.
  • Ages: many venues ask for an adult in teams with younger children.

sections.h2: How to play like a pro
sections.html:
1. Search everything: under rugs, behind pictures, inside books.
  2. Pile your finds in one place so everyone can see them.
  3. Split up to work on separate puzzles, then regroup.
  4. Talk constantly: say what you’ve found and what you’ve tried.
  5. Use hints when you’re stuck for a few minutes. The goal is fun.
Escape rooms make brilliant teen birthday outings: a fixed time, a shared challenge and a photo with the sign at the end. See more teen birthday ideas and find rooms in our escape rooms guide.

faqs.a: Most aren’t. They’re puzzle games with a theme. Horror-themed rooms can be scary and often have higher age limits, so check the description.

faqs.q: How many people do you need for an escape room?
faqs.a: Most rooms take between 2 and 6 players. Check the venue’s recommended team size.
